data_contract.neural: Participant-level regional BOLD time series, both with and without global-signal regression; publisher specifies dimensions and condition columns.
data_contract.labels: Dataset3 columns baseline/light/deep/recovery; Dataset4 baseline/light/surgical; Dataset5 N1/N2/N3/awake. These labels make state comparisons possible without figure values.
data_contract.split: Within-person state contrast; hold out complete participants/cohorts for predictive extensions. No random overlapping-window splits.
data_contract.controls: Matched GSR/noGSR inputs required by the original metric; compare motion/global-amplitude and simpler correlation strength, surrogate time series preserving autocorrelation.
data_contract.time_alignment: Static state metric initially avoids unknown transition-event timing. Sliding-window transition claims require exact TR and responsiveness annotation audit.

versions_and_loader_contract.scope_description: Recompute the central integration-segregation metric and state contrasts from released regional fMRI time series; initial bounded scope uses explicitly labeled sedation/sleep conditions in datasets3–5, not the unreleased transition annotations needed for every temporal figure.
